_about: An appeal or motion after a USCIS denial (Form I-290B, src/motion.py), per uscis.gov/i-290b (updated 06/01/2026): the G-28 and the I-290B, then a copy of the decision, the brief, and the new evidence (a motion to reopen). One I-290B for each decision. USCIS's chart says which decisions can be appealed. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: Motion or appeal after a USCIS denial (I-290B)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: The brief: the attorney's argument (a motion to reconsider cites the law or policy the decision got wrong; a motion to reopen states the new facts, with their evidence).
Exactly ONE box in Part 2: an appeal or a motion, never both; USCIS may reject a form with more than one.
USCIS must RECEIVE it by the deadline on the panel: send it with tracking, early.

exhibits.title: The decision appealed or reopened (the denial notice)
Other USCIS notices on the case

leave_out.intake_questionnaire: The firm's own intake questionnaire: internal.
leave_out.translation_certification: Goes with the document it translates.
leave_out.g28: The firm files a new G-28 with this filing.
leave_out.i485: Not sent again: USCIS has it (an SIJ I-290B: don't include a copy of the original I-360 or I-485).
